title: This Red-Hot Shuttle Tile Could Be Held in Bare Hands

scenes.text: A glowing red-hot tile could be held in bare hands.
Space shuttles faced about 2,300 degrees Fahrenheit coming back to Earth.
Special silica tiles covered the underside to block that heat.
About 90 percent of each tile is empty space, so heat barely travels through it.
A tile could glow red on one side while someone held the other.
Fire on one side. Bare hands on the other.

description:
A glowing red-hot space shuttle tile could be held in bare hands.
The tiles are about 90 percent empty space, so heat barely travels through them.
Would you have held it?
first_comment: Would you hold a glowing tile? Honest answer.
